source_followup.az.2020.1.3: Check the direction and operands of the floor-divisibility condition against the official source. For a>=2 and sufficiently large n, the nonnegative quantity floor(a^n/b)-1 is smaller than a^n+1, so divisibility would force floor(a^n/b)=1 indefinitely; no b can satisfy this. For a=1 the stated hypothesis also cannot hold.
source_followup.sg.2013.0.3: The opening quantifier names n, the existence quantifier names n again, and the target number of distinct prime factors is N, which is not defined. Check the intended variable names against the official source.
source_followup.id.2008.1.4: The remainder index in the displayed alternating sum runs from 0 to 7 although remainders modulo 7 run from 0 to 6. Check the modulus, range and identity against the official source before editing.
source_followup.id.2013.1.1: The statement requires a particular drawing of interior segments, but no figure URL is stored. Obtain the original diagram before attempting to determine the intended parallelogram count.
source_followup.id.2024.1.2: The domain of the fatal triple (a,b,c) is unspecified. The intended positive-integer restriction must be checked: with positive reals, a=(-3+sqrt(137))/4, b=2a, c=2a^2 sum to 16 and satisfy ab=c, contradicting part (a).
source_followup.jp.1996.0.1: Check the strict angle comparison against the official source. In an equilateral triangular tiling, choose ABC to be one tile: its circumcircle has no other vertex in its interior and theta=60 degrees, but no triangle can have all three angles strictly greater than theta.
